key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:014C
name: initialise_handle_record
description: Stores a fixed mode value, consults a flag byte through a table lookup and a called routine, then sets the link field, clears the pointer fields and returns the record. It calls one routine and is called by one other.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:0156
name: open_handle_and_initialise_record
description: Picks an access value from a flag byte and passes it with a stored field to a called routine, returning null if that call fails. On success it stores a second flag-selected value, sets the link field and clears the pointer fields before returning the record.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:0160
name: open_record_with_arguments
description: Passes its two arguments to a called routine and returns null if the result is minus one. Otherwise it stores a flag-selected value, sets the link field, clears the pointer fields and returns the record.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:0184
name: set_record_mode_and_initialise
description: Stores a flag-selected value of one or the other in a local, consults a table flag through a called routine, then sets the link field, clears the pointer fields and returns the record.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:0192
name: initialise_record_with_mode_one
description: Stores the constant one as the mode value, consults a table flag through a called routine, then sets the link field, clears the pointer fields and returns the record.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:019A
name: open_record_with_write_flags
description: Combines an access value chosen from a flag byte with the caller's request bits and fixed bits, then passes the result to a called routine with a permission value. It returns null on failure, and on success stores a second flag-selected value and sets up the record fields.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:01A4
name: open_record_with_create_flags
description: Combines the caller's request bits with a fixed bit pattern and passes them to a called routine with a permission value. It returns null on failure, and on success stores a fixed mode value and sets up the record fields before returning it.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:01DC
name: set_record_flags_and_initialise
description: Stores a flag-selected value of one or the other as the mode, consults a table flag through a called routine, then sets the link field, clears the pointer fields and returns the record.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:01EA
name: initialise_record_with_mode_two
description: Stores the constant two as the mode value, consults a table flag through a called routine, then sets the link field, clears the pointer fields and returns the record.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:01F2
name: stub_return_zero
description: Does nothing except return zero; it is a three-instruction stub with no other behaviour.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:01F8
name: initialise_record_from_lookup
description: Calls a routine and then either clears the link field or sets a flag bit and points the link field at an offset within the record. It then stores a saved value, clears the pointer fields and returns the record.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:022A
name: finish_record_without_link
description: Clears the link field of the record, copies a saved value into it, clears the two pointer fields and returns the record.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:025A
name: clear_object_links
description: Releases the first linked object when a flag bit is set, and releases the second linked object when its flag bits are clear and its pointer is non-zero. It then zeroes the two pointer fields and the flag byte and passes a stored byte to a called routine.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0000
name: lookup_valid_table_entry
description: Checks that the index is non-negative and below a limit and that the table entry at that index is marked in use, then returns the entry's address. Otherwise it stores error code 9 and returns null.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:005C
name: claim_slot_and_open_file
description: Finds a free entry in a fixed table, marks it with access and direction bits taken from the mode argument, optionally deletes the named file and then opens it. It returns the slot index, or minus one with an error code when no slot is free, the mode is invalid or the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:008C
name: open_slot_from_record
description: Uses the record's stored slot to set its direction and access bits, optionally deletes the named file and opens it, storing the returned handle in the record. It returns the slot index, or minus one with an error code when the slot is out of range, the mode is invalid or the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:00A6
name: open_record_slot_for_request
description: Derives the access and direction bits for the record's slot from its mode field, optionally deletes the named file and opens it, storing the handle in the record. It returns minus one with an error code if the mode is invalid or the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:00DE
name: open_record_after_slot_setup
description: Sets the slot's base flag, adds access bits derived from the mode field, optionally deletes the named file and opens it, storing the handle. It returns minus one with an error code for an invalid mode or a failed open.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0118
name: open_slot_with_mode_bit
description: Adds a mode-derived bit to the slot byte, optionally deletes the named file and opens it, then stores the handle. It clears the slot and returns minus one if the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0124
name: open_slot_with_fixed_mode
description: Sets a fixed access bit in the slot byte, optionally deletes the named file and opens it, then stores the handle. It clears the slot and returns minus one if the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:013A
name: open_slot_with_combined_mode
description: Sets a flag-selected bit and a combined access pattern in the slot byte, optionally deletes the named file and opens it, then stores the handle. It clears the slot and returns minus one if the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0146
name: open_slot_with_access_pattern
description: Adds a fixed access pattern to the slot byte, optionally deletes the named file and opens it, then stores the handle. It clears the slot and returns minus one if the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:015C
name: reject_invalid_mode_request
description: Clears the slot byte, records error code 22 and returns minus one, rejecting the request without opening anything.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0170
name: open_named_file_from_flags
description: Optionally deletes the named file, chooses an open mode from the request bits and opens the file, storing the handle in the slot. On failure it records the I/O error, sets error code 2, clears the slot and returns minus one.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:019C
name: open_file_with_constant_mode
description: Opens the named file with a fixed mode constant and stores the returned handle in the record. On failure it records the I/O error, sets error code 2, clears the slot and returns minus one.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:01E0
name: return_saved_local_value
description: Returns the four-byte value held in a local stack slot without doing anything else.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:01E8
name: forward_open_request_with_flags
description: Forwards the first argument unchanged to another routine, together with two values derived from the second: its top bit combined with a fixed set of access bits, and its remaining bits unchanged.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:021A
name: read_bytes_from_handle
description: Rejects negative lengths and unknown handles with error code 22 and minus one. Otherwise it reads the requested bytes from the handle, and if the read fails it records the I/O error and sets error code 5.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0244
name: read_bytes_into_buffer
description: Reads the requested number of bytes from the handle held in a local record into the given buffer and stores the result. On failure it records the I/O error and sets error code 5.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0282
name: write_bytes_to_handle
description: Rejects negative lengths and unknown handles with error code 22. Otherwise, if the handle's flag bit is set it seeks to the end first, then writes the bytes, recording the I/O error and error code 5 if the write fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0306
name: seek_using_offset_table
description: Seeks an open handle to a position taken from a three-entry table indexed by the third argument, recording the I/O error and setting error code 22 if that seek fails. It then seeks back to the start and returns that result, or returns minus one with error code 22 for an unknown handle or an index of three or more.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:038E
name: close_handle_and_clear_slot
description: Closes the handle in the given slot unless its flag bit is set, recording the I/O error and error code 5 if the close fails, then clears the slot. It returns minus one for an unknown slot, zero if the flag bit was already set, and otherwise the close status.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:03FC
name: delete_named_file
description: Deletes the named file and returns zero on success. On failure it records the I/O error, sets error code 2 and returns minus one.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:042A
name: stub_return_zero_status
description: Does nothing except return zero, so it is a stub with no other behaviour.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0478
name: open_default_file_into_global
description: Opens the named file with a fixed mode constant and stores the returned handle in a global variable, with no error handling.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0494
name: read_buffered_byte
description: Returns a pending byte from a one-byte buffer and clears it when one is set. Otherwise it reads a single byte from the handle, first calling a routine if no handle has been set.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:04CC
name: read_single_byte_from_handle
description: Reads one byte from the global handle into a local stack slot and returns that byte.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:051C
name: write_single_byte_to_handle
description: Writes its single byte argument to the global handle, first calling a routine if no handle has been set, and returns that byte.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:62:0000
name: forward_two_arguments
description: Forwards its two arguments unchanged to another routine and returns without any other work.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:0000
name: read_byte_from_refilled_buffer
description: Returns the next byte from the record's buffer and decrements its count, refilling the buffer through a read when it is empty. It returns minus one if the record's error or end flags are set, and it first initialises the buffer through a called routine when none is attached.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:001A
name: read_buffered_byte_after_init
description: Initialises the record's buffer through a called routine when no buffer is set and the record's mode bit is clear, returning minus one if that fails. It then returns the next buffered byte, refilling the buffer through a read when it is empty and returning minus one if the error or end flags are set.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:0040
name: read_byte_refilling_buffer
description: Returns the next buffered byte, first refilling the buffer through a read when it is empty. It returns minus one if the record's error or end flags are set.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:0056
name: fill_buffer_and_return_byte
description: Returns minus one if the record's flag bit is set, otherwise it reads a fresh buffer load through a called routine and records error or end flags from its count. It then returns the next byte from the refilled buffer.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:006A
name: refill_and_read_buffer_byte
description: Marks the record as in use and fills its buffer through a called routine, recording error or end flags from the result. It then returns the next buffered byte, or minus one if a flag bit is set after the fill.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:00F6
name: take_next_buffered_byte
description: Decrements the buffer count and returns the next byte, calling a routine to refill the buffer when the count goes negative.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:0112
name: forward_record_to_routine
description: Passes the record pointer held in a local slot to another routine and returns nothing else.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:0120
name: write_byte_into_buffer
description: Writes one byte from the argument into the record's output buffer and decrements its count, flushing through a called routine when the buffer is full. It can also flush on request, setting the error or short-write flag from the flush result.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:0382
name: allocate_record_buffer
description: Returns zero if the record already has a buffer and its flag bit is clear. Otherwise it obtains a new buffer through a called routine, stores it in the record and clears the state bits and counters, setting error code 12 and returning minus one on failure.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:38:0000
name: scale_global_by_eight
description: Returns a global variable multiplied by eight, using a left shift by three bits.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:38:0010
name: forward_value_twice
description: Passes its single argument to another routine as both arguments and returns.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:38:0026
name: allocate_from_free_list
description: Allocates a block of the requested size from a free list kept in globals, splitting a larger block when needed and reducing the free total. Non-positive sizes return null, and when no block fits it obtains a new region through called routines and retries.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:38:010A
name: forward_with_repeated_second
description: Forwards its two arguments to another routine with the second argument repeated as a third argument, then returns.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:38:0124
name: release_block_to_free_list
description: Returns a block to the address-sorted free list held in globals, merging it with an adjacent block when they touch and adding its size to the free total. It returns minus one without changes for a non-positive size or a block that overlaps a free block.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:77:0000
name: report_pending_break_signal
description: Checks the task's signal mask for the Ctrl-C and Ctrl-D break bits and returns zero when neither is set. When a break is pending and a global flag is set, it writes a caret, the letter C or D and a newline, then calls a routine for each index up to a global count.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:75:0000
name: compute_signed_magnitude_division
description: Divides two 32-bit values using their magnitudes in a restoring shift-and-subtract loop over 32 bits, then applies the sign of the xor of the inputs to the quotient. It returns zero when either input is zero.

name: load_executable_hunks
description: Loads an AmigaDOS executable's hunks into allocated memory, copying code and data hunks and reserving space for BSS hunks. It then applies 32-bit relocation records by adding each block's load address to the words they point to.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: Contains no instructions beyond returning, so it is an empty stub.

name: delay_by_counting_down
description: Spins in a countdown loop over a register value for the requested count, with no other effects. It returns once the loop finishes.

name: unpack_backward_compressed_stream
description: Expands a packed byte stream from the end of its destination towards the start, writing literal bytes and back-references whose lengths are sums of read codes. Repeated codes of three, four and seven select the copy lengths, and the loop stops when the write position reaches the start address.

name: decrement_byte_with_space_wrap
description: Decrements a byte register once for each unit of a counter, replacing a zero result with a space character. It makes no memory accesses or calls and returns after the loop.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains only undecodable instruction data, so it is a stub with no usable behaviour.

name: scan_bitmask_transitions
description: Walks tables of bit-mask words, comparing each bit with the previous one and calling through a function table when the value changes, while counting the changes in a global. Only the first part of this long routine is readable, so the description covers its visible loops.

name: zero_data_block_and_setup
description: Clears a block of longwords in the data area and records the global base pointer. It then calls through the library table when a status bit is set, and calls a second routine chosen by a lookup result.

name: allocate_demo_picture_buffers
description: Allocates four memory blocks of fixed sizes and stores their addresses, then runs a sequence of calls and branches on a parameter to choose between two call sequences. The routine's text reference is demo.pic.

name: start_copper_from_record
description: Passes a value read through a pointer in a record to the copper-list starter, which points the copper at a new copper list. It does nothing else.

name: register_buffers_with_sizes
description: Passes four stored buffer addresses with their sizes to three called routines, then stores a fixed value in a global. It also touches the INTENA interrupt-enable register.

name: create_process_from_startup_record
description: Allocates a 40-byte structure, sets its name and size fields from the startup text reference and zeroes its other fields, then hands it to a process-creation routine. The text referenced includes the program name Populous.prg.

name: allocate_and_index_buffer_table
description: Allocates a 1152-byte block with a memory-type flag and fills an eight-entry table of addresses spaced 144 bytes apart within it. It then calls another routine and stores two addresses derived from the table for later use.

name: store_fixed_count_and_call
description: Stores the constant 399 in a word slot of the frame and then calls another routine.

name: process_stored_buffer_block
description: Passes the buffer allocated earlier and its size of 1152 bytes to another routine.

name: call_with_two_stored_values
description: Calls another routine twice, first with a stored pointer and then with a second stored value.

name: call_library_vector_with_word
description: Passes a stored value and the low word of its argument to a library stub, which loads a library base and jumps through its vector.

name: call_single_routine
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns.

name: find_entry_and_dispatch
description: Searches a two-entry table for the given value and, on a match, calls another routine with the paired entry. It stores the index reached in a frame slot.

name: swap_pair_and_call
description: Swaps two stored four-byte values in the frame and then calls another routine with the swapped pair.

name: open_system_libraries
description: Obtains a base address and then opens the graphics and intuition libraries by name, storing each returned base and calling a routine when one fails. It records a flag bit read from the graphics base in a frame slot.

name: wait_for_selection_then_dispatch
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until it returns one, two or three, then calls another routine with a stored value and a frame address.

name: wait_then_classify_stored_values
description: Starts a sequence using the text reference load.pic, polls for a flag to clear for a bounded number of iterations, then classifies two stored coordinate values into a code from zero to three.

name: install_handlers_and_run_loop
description: Installs two routine pointers and sets initial values for a table of sixteen 14-byte entries. It then loops, toggling a flag and calling routines over subsets of the entries until the loop's flag is cleared.

name: step_byte_coded_event_stream
description: Steps through a byte-coded event stream for a set of channels, treating small codes as note updates, middle codes as table updates and the top codes as pattern-control commands, and calling routines to output each event. The source is truncated partway, so the description covers only the visible branches.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return, so it is an empty stub.

name: setup_entries_and_run_loop
description: Initialises eighteen table entries with a fixed value and a three-bit value from a called routine, then loops calling routines to output each entry's offset until a stop flag is set. It returns zero on one path and one when the loop finishes.

name: initialise_entry_pairs_from_routine
description: For each entry in the given count, stores a value in the range 232 to 244 and a value from zero to eight, both taken as remainders of results from a called routine.

name: update_entry_pairs_and_return_first
description: Updates each entry pair by subtracting its second value from its first after adding one, clamping negative results to zero and halving the step in that case. It returns the first non-zero step recorded.

name: run_demo_picture_loop
description: Sets up state and calls routines while the loop condition holds, checking a stop flag on each pass, then calls a library routine through a stub to finish. The text reference is demo.pic.

name: compute_plane_buffer_addresses
description: Computes four pairs of buffer addresses from stored bases, stepping by 300 and 32000 bytes, and passes each pair with two frame pointers to a called routine. It then copies the last pair of bases into frame slots.

name: load_32000_bytes_from_file
description: Opens the named file for reading, reads 32000 bytes into a stored buffer, passes the buffer on to another routine and closes the file. It returns zero on success and minus one if the file cannot be opened.

name: load_asset_files_into_buffers
description: Opens and reads several data files named in its text references, font.dat, land0 and sprites0.dat, into fixed-size buffers, closing each file after its reads. The byte counts are 114, 33600, 23520 and 4400.

name: load_40000_byte_block_file
description: Opens the named file for reading, reads 40000 bytes into the caller's buffer and then 64 bytes into a second local buffer, and closes the file. It does nothing if the file cannot be opened.

name: blit_bitplanes_from_source_table
description: Draws four bitplanes into the screen buffer at a given position, shifting each 16-bit source word by the low bits of the horizontal coordinate and combining it with masked destination words. It returns early when the vertical position lies outside a fixed range.

name: blit_sprite_from_fixed_source
description: Draws a masked, shifted sprite from a fixed source table into the screen buffer, combining four bitplanes word by word at a given position. It returns early when the vertical position lies outside the allowed range.

name: call_routine_return_pair
description: Calls another routine and returns the register values it leaves as a pair.

name: draw_masked_plane_blocks
description: Draws a block of bitplane words into the screen buffer, combining each source word with an AND mask and an OR value for every plane in turn. The source is read from a global table at the given offset, and the routine returns early when the vertical coordinate is outside its range.

name: rotate_entry_table_fields
description: Rotates the fields of each of 1680 twenty-byte entries in a global table by one slot, moving the high and low words of the stored long values into neighbouring positions.

name: shift_buffer_bytes_left_three
description: Shifts each byte of a fixed 100-byte buffer left by three bits, discarding the overflow.

name: draw_ten_by_ten_grid
description: Loops over a ten-by-ten grid of entries, computing a position for each cell from its row, column and a stored offset, and passes it to a called routine. Cells with a flag set also trigger a second routine call.

name: call_routine_pass_through_result
description: Calls another routine and returns the register values it leaves as a pair.

name: set_text_pointer_to_global
description: Stores the address of a global buffer in a pointer variable. The text referenced here is POPULOUS +.

name: render_text_into_five_planes
description: First fills 80 longwords with minus one and 320 longwords with zero, then renders the string held in a pointer variable by copying each character's eight-row glyph from a font table into five bitplane buffers.

name: open_library_via_vector_table
description: Looks up a library through a vector table and, when it is found, calls its setup vectors and stores several global values before returning. When the lookup fails, it calls two cleanup vectors and returns. The same code appears at several neighbouring addresses because of overlapping decode.

name: clear_status_byte_and_return
description: Clears one status byte at a fixed offset in a structure and returns the value it was given.

name: restore_interrupt_registers
description: Writes the mask that clears all interrupt enable bits, calls a library routine to free memory, then restores the saved register values. It finishes by writing the saved enable value with its top two bits set.

name: dispatch_status_code_and_clear
description: Calls a routine for a status code of ten or one, then clears the status byte at a fixed offset in the structure before returning.

name: clear_status_after_code_one
description: Calls a routine when the code is one, then clears the status byte at a fixed offset in the structure before returning.

name: clear_status_byte_only
description: Clears one status byte at a fixed offset in a structure and returns the value it was given.

name: clear_status_byte_only

name: poll_interrupt_flag_bit
description: Checks one flag bit in a global word and, when it is set, writes a status byte, updates the word and calls another routine. The facts list interrupt control registers for this routine.

name: init_sound_channel_periods
description: Reads eight channel records from a data block, storing for each a pointer to its sample data, a half-length value and a period computed by dividing a fixed clock constant by the record's rate. It then sets two table entries from routine-relative pointers and initialises per-channel state from a selected table entry.

name: init_sound_channel_periods
description: Reads eight channel records from a data block, storing for each a pointer to its sample data, a half-length value and a period computed by dividing a fixed clock constant by the record's rate. It then sets two table entries from routine-relative pointers and initialises per-channel state from a selected table entry.

name: disable_audio_channels_dma
description: Clears a global status byte and writes masks to the audio control and DMA control registers, which clears the audio DMA enable bits.

name: update_audio_channel_registers
description: Returns early when a global flag byte is clear. Otherwise, for each of four audio channels, it writes the channel's sample start address and length into the custom chip registers, using a silent sample when the length is zero.

name: step_audio_channel_stream
description: Steps the byte-coded stream for each audio channel, updating its remaining length and reading new note data when it runs out. It writes period and volume values to the audio registers and also touches the DMA control register at its start.

name: decode_audio_channel_event
description: Reads the next byte-coded event for an audio channel, storing the new sample pointer, period and volume in the channel record and in its audio register copies. It sets the channel's remaining count from a scaled stream value.

name: decode_channel_sequence_entry
description: Looks up a channel record in a table indexed by a stream byte and stores its sample pointers in the channel state, then decodes the next byte-coded event for that channel.

name: service_all_audio_channels
description: Loops over the four audio channels from last to first, updating each channel's sequence state and writing its start address, length and period to the custom chip registers. It returns when the channel counter underflows.

name: start_channel_dma_from_event
description: Reads a byte-coded event for a channel and writes its period, volume and start address into the channel record and its audio register copies. It then sets the channel's DMA enable bit in the control word.

name: decode_channel_event_and_enable
description: Stores the channel's sequence byte, reads the next event, and sets its period, volume and sample pointers. It then enables the channel's DMA bit in the control word.

name: cycle_channel_pointer_list_events
description: Advances a channel's pointer through a list of sequence entries, wrapping to the start of the list at its end. It then reads the next byte-coded event and writes its period and volume to the audio registers.

name: decode_event_and_set_dma
description: Decodes an event for a channel from a value already held in a register, updating its period, volume and sample pointer. It then writes the channel's DMA bits to the DMA control register.

name: apply_channel_period_effects
description: Applies per-tick effects to a channel: it adds the stored step to the period when a flag bit is set, and adds a pitch adjustment computed from a table value divided by a rate. It updates the channel's pointer and the audio period register.

name: stop_channel_and_service_rest
description: Clears the stored sample byte and period field for a channel, then services the remaining audio channels in order, writing their start address and length to the audio registers until the counter underflows.

name: service_channels_with_clamp
description: Services audio channels from last to first, clearing a flag and a stored sample byte when a counter passes a limit before continuing the loop. It returns when the channel counter underflows.

name: reset_channel_byte_and_service
description: Sets a channel's stored byte to 60 and continues the channel service loop, returning when the counter underflows.

name: blend_pattern_into_bitplanes
description: Copies source words into four bitplanes over 64 rows, taking each bit from the source where the pattern bit is clear and keeping the destination bit where it is set. The pattern is read from a three-entry table that cycles for each row.

name: merge_pattern_row_into_planes
description: Merges a row of 160 source words with a pattern from a table into four bitplanes, cycling through three pattern words. Pattern bits are combined with the source bits and the destination bits are updated word by word.

name: store_stack_word_and_call
description: Stores a word passed on the stack into a global variable and then calls another routine.

name: forward_call_no_args
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns.

name: update_position_from_input_bytes
description: Updates a horizontal position from the change in the low byte of an input word, wrapping the difference and clamping the result to zero through 639 before halving it. The high byte is handled the same way for the vertical position, and any non-zero result is passed to a routine.

name: save_input_bytes_and_call
description: Saves the low byte and high byte of a global input word into two saved globals, then calls another routine. The facts list the joystick data register for this routine.

name: save_interrupt_state_and_enable
description: Saves the current interrupt enable word in two saved globals, then writes a set-bits mask to the interrupt enable register.

name: restore_saved_interrupt_enable
description: If a saved interrupt enable value is non-zero, it clears all enable bits, writes back the saved value with its top two bits set, clears the saved value and returns it. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: build_copper_palette_list
description: Builds a copper list in memory by writing display window, data fetch and bitplane control values, choosing one of two window positions from a global. It then writes a 32-entry table from its input into the colour register entries.

name: write_request_bit_and_wait
description: Writes its argument and then a value four higher to a global register, then loops until the request bit is set. It returns the combined value once the bit reads back as set.

name: wait_for_request_bit_set
description: Writes the request bit value to a global register and polls the same register until that bit reads back as set, then returns that bit.

name: append_values_to_copper_list
description: Finds the first colour register entry in a copper list and writes the values from a source array into the following entries, two words apart.

name: unknown_routine_no_pseudocode
description: Only its call relationship is known: one unnamed routine calls it and it runs 21 instructions. The decompiler timed out, so its behaviour cannot be described from the evidence.

name: write_sprite_control_block
description: Looks up a control block from a table indexed by an argument and writes its start positions and flag bits into the block and its duplicate fields. The vertical start is offset by a value that depends on a global flag.

name: decode_raw_keyboard_code
description: Reads a raw keyboard code from the keyboard serial register, ignores key releases and converts the code to a character through a key table. The table text begins with the digits one to zero and the symbols minus, equals and grave. It stores the decoded key in a global and sets a pending flag.

name: copy_32000_byte_block
description: Copies 8000 longwords, which is 32000 bytes, from one buffer to another.

name: step_palette_components_toward_zero
description: Copies a palette of entries into a local buffer, then repeatedly decrements each 4-bit colour component toward zero until every component is zero, calling routines on each step. It also reads the raster position register.

name: call_then_forward_result
description: Calls one routine with no arguments, then passes its two arguments through to another routine and returns that routine's result.

name: call_and_conditional_followup
description: Passes its argument to another routine and then calls a second routine when a stored value is non-zero.

name: advance_seed_return_high_word
description: Adds 12345 to the value returned by a called routine, stores the sum, and returns its high word with the top bit cleared.

name: store_high_word_of_argument
description: Stores the high word of its argument in a stored location and does nothing else.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Contains only a return and does nothing.

name: allocate_tagged_record_block
description: Allocates a record sized from a table entry, initialises its fields and writes a four-character tag into its header. It then either links the record or sets its flag bits depending on a field of the referenced object, and returns early if the allocation fails.

name: copy_named_string_to_record
description: Copies a null-terminated string from a global table entry into a newly allocated buffer, storing its length and pointer in the record. It then calls a library routine with the buffer, and the rest of the body is only partly shown.

name: append_string_bounded
description: Appends a null-terminated source string to a destination string, copying no more than 32767 characters and terminating the result when the copy is cut short. It returns the destination.

name: append_string_with_limit
description: Appends a null-terminated source string to a destination string, stopping after the count in the third argument and adding a terminator when the copy is cut short. It returns the destination.

name: copy_string_padded_to_length
description: Copies up to a given number of characters from a source string into a destination, then pads the rest of the destination with zero bytes up to that length. It returns the destination.

name: multiply_32bit_values
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values from the register inputs using 16-bit partial products, returning the combined product.

name: open_window_and_icon_resources
description: Opens icon.library and obtains a window-related entry from it, storing the returned pointers in the record. It then releases the handles it acquired. The text referenced includes WINDOW and icon.library.

name: call_stored_callback_then_routine
description: Calls a stored routine pointer when it is set, then calls another routine.

name: call_stored_callback_then_routine

name: release_stored_resources
description: Releases resources held in the record in turn: it frees each entry of a table, calls a stored callback, and releases any stored handles that are non-null. It stores a saved value into a pointer target and calls a library routine when a flag bit is set.

name: close_table_entry_handle
description: Checks that an index is within the table and that its entry is in use, returning minus one and setting error code 2 otherwise. For a valid entry it closes the handle unless a flag bit is set, then clears the entry and returns zero.

name: call_dos_close_vector
description: Calls the library vector for closing through the stored library base at a fixed offset, and returns.

name: call_dos_open_vector

name: call_library_close_sequence
description: Calls a routine and, when the zero flag is clear, calls a second routine and then a library vector through a stored base. It then calls a third routine and returns.

name: open_dos_library

name: launch_program_process_from_startup
description: Opens dos.library, looks up the task, and creates a process for populous.prg, exchanging messages with it and releasing memory afterwards. It also copies a data region to another address, and the body is long enough that only its main steps are visible.

name: increment_counter_clear_bit
description: Library code, part of icon.library: increments a 16-bit counter at a fixed offset from a base pointer and clears one bit in a status byte at another offset.

name: decrement_counter_and_dispatch
description: Library code, part of icon.library: decrements a 16-bit counter at a fixed offset and, when it reaches zero with a flag bit set, calls another routine and returns its result. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: unlink_node_and_release
description: Library code, part of icon.library: when a counter field is zero, it unlinks a node from a doubly linked list and calls a library vector to release it. Otherwise it sets a flag bit and returns zero.

name: set_flag_bit_return_zero

name: copy_record_fields_to_globals
